items.title: Manuel Mello Interview, 1959-08-03
items.q: he might have made a record with Raymond, Burke, not too long ago.

ctx.x: Did Lyle's work with many bands that you didn't work with? Well,

he worked with Galatay. He worked with Christian. He worked with Baraka. And he worked with Monjada, Triangle Officer. Which Monjada's in it? Sato. Sam. The clarinet player? I believe it is. And which Christian? Frank Christian played cornet. And Beans Christian, Emil, he played cornet. And who else did the horse play? He lost the horse to somebody else. His main hole after he left us was to play with Frank Christian. We made a swap. I took Charlie and he went over to play. Plus he had some kind of disagreement…
I haven't heard anything from him in a long time.
